messages:
Alex: Heads up — HR sync assigned "OrgAdmin" group to 12 more people overnight. Noticed via audit logs. Need quick triage for shadow admins. @oncall?
Maria: Putting an initial list here (csv attached to ticket): alice.g, dev-ci, contractor-22, hr-sync-bot, svc-reporting — 4 look suspicious by role and last active date.
Sam: Query I used to find attach events (cloudtrail):
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=AttachGroupPolicy --max-results 50 --query 'Events[?contains(Resources[].ResourceName, `OrgAdmin`)]'
```
Run with `--start-time` for the 24h window.
Jordan: :eyes: Also flagged: KMS grants from svc-ci-runner to prod-key (kms:Decrypt) across two projects. If we prune group membership CI might fail.
Ops: Confirmed — svc-ci-runner has GrantId g-73 on prod-key-1. I'll apply a temporary deny for non-staging zones for 2h and monitor failures so we can prune safely.
sec-bot: scheduled reminder — quarterly-access-review due in 3 days. See runbook at /docs/runbooks/access-review
Maria: For audit/compliance we need an evidence bundle (auth events + owner attestations). Alex — can you own the ticket creation and distribution?
Alex: Yep. I'll open INC-4883, add owners: Maria (evidence), Sam (logs), Jordan (rollback plan). Canary window 24h; rollback plan documented.
Jordan: Rollback snippet (idempotent):
```
#!/bin/bash
# remove OrgAdmin from listed users, sleep 10s to verify, re-add if errors
for u in $(cat prune-list.txt); do
  aws iam remove-user-from-group --group-name OrgAdmin --user-name $u || { echo "fail $u"; exit 1; }
done
```
Sam: Before mass prune I'll run a scoped dry-run to detect dependent principals:
- check KMS grants
- check service tokens
- check CI jobs referencing 'OrgAdmin'
I'll post results here within ~40m.
Maria: Also requested HR to pause group sync until we finish. @people-ops please confirm.
Ops: HR sync paused. Noting pager noise suppressed for the deny window. :thumbsup:
Alex: Thanks — if anyone finds a critical business owner that must keep access, tag here with justification. We'll keep a 24h rollback window and a clear owner for each exception.
Sam: Starting the audit now (scoped dry-run). Will post log excerpt when complete.
Alex: Thanks everyone. :seedling:
